sheets_hint: Connect your Google account once, then turn on the stores you want: each store gets a file with all its orders, and every new order is added within a minute. Change the status from the dropdown in the sheet and it changes in the store, and the other way around.
sheets_privacy: We only access the file we create for you — not the rest of your Google Drive.
sheets_disconnect_confirm: Disconnect the Google account? Sync stops for every store; the files stay in your account.
sheets_status_file_missing: File deleted — turn the store off and on again to create a new one
sheets_ok_connected: Account connected! Now turn on the stores you want to sync.
sheets_err_denied: You cancelled in the Google window.
sheets_err_scope: Access to Google Drive files must be allowed in the Google window. Try again and tick the box.
sheets_err_state: The connection timed out, try again.
sheets_err_google: Could not connect to Google, try again.
sheets_how_1: Every new order is added at the bottom of the sheet.
sheets_how_2: Change the status from the dropdown → it changes in the store within a minute.
sheets_how_3: A change from the dashboard or the courier → shows up in the sheet.
sheets_how_4: “Who confirms” column in the sheet: “I confirm” → the order is reserved for you for 20 minutes (no company, and your store team can’t edit it); a company → it is sent there with the preferred agents; empty → follows auto-send. Agent, dates and attempts show up automatically.
sheets_how_4_self: “Who confirms” column in the sheet: pick “I confirm” → the order is reserved for you for 20 minutes, and your store team can’t edit it meanwhile. The time shows in the “I confirm” until column.
sheets_ok_enabled: “{{name}}” is on — its orders are being added to the file…
sheets_stores_hint: Turn a store on to create its file and start syncing. Turning it off keeps the file; turning it back on continues in it.
apikeys_hint: Use an API key to connect your account to Claude or ChatGPT via MCP: manage stores, products, categories and landing pages (list, create, edit, recoverable delete). Deleting a store and permanent deletes stay in the dashboard only.
apikeys_new_warning: Copy this key now and store it somewhere safe. It will not be shown again.
apikeys_mcp_hint: Paste this URL in the “URL” field when adding a custom connector in Claude or ChatGPT, with “No authentication”. Do not share it.
apikeys_revoke_confirm: Revoke this key? Any connection using it will stop working immediately.
